subject: candidates: Charybdis
reason: True positive, but nothing to fix: the corpus names Charybdis 17x (Apollodorus E.7.20-E.7.23, Odyssey 12, Ovid) and every mention is a sea hazard in a strait -- 'in the other cliff was Charybdis, who thrice a day drew up the water and spouted it again'. No parentage, marriage, killing, or any other relation in the existing vocabulary is attested for her anywhere in the six sources (unlike Scylla, whose parents Apollodorus does name at E.7.20, and who has 17 rows). Odysseus passes her but does not fight or kill her, and there is no 'encountered' relation; inventing one to satisfy this check would be the tail wagging the dog, and fabricating a parentage is the DEV-047/DEV-095 line this project does not cross. Revisit if P5b's myth/participant work adds a modeling shape for 'hazard encountered during a voyage'.

subject: candidates: Demodocus
reason: True positive, but nothing to fix: the corpus names Demodocus 11x, all in Odyssey 8, and all as the blind Phaeacian minstrel at Alcinous's court -- 'summon hither the divine minstrel, Demodocus; for to him above all others has the god granted skill in song'. No kinship, marriage, or death is stated, and 'court bard of Alcinous' has no honest match in the existing relation vocabulary (servant_of overstates a minstrel the king summons as an honoured guest-performer). subject: Tlepolemus killed_by Sarpedon
reason: False positive, and the worked example of A12's one structural limit -- pronoun anaphora. Iliad 5.657-659 has BOTH men strike: "Sarpedon smote him full upon the neck, and the grievous point passed clean through, and down upon his eyes came the darkness of night" (Tlepolemus dies -- Sarpedon is the killer, so the seeded edge is CORRECT), immediately followed by "And Tlepolemus smote Sarpedon upon the left thigh" (a wound, not a kill). A12 sees the second and not the first, because the first names its victim with the pronoun "him". No regex over entity names can resolve that reference, so `correct == 0` cannot suppress it here. Verified against the passage 2026-07-29 (DEV-123); the edge is right and must NOT be swapped.
